biotools.summary: C-IMMSIM is an immunoinformatics tool used to predict and simulate immune responses, specifically for the development of broad-spectrum vaccines against viruses like Bluetongue. It integrates protein docking, molecular dynamics, and cytokine response prediction for vaccine design.
